details.short_description: Provides the client's protocol version, and requests [`NetworkSettings`](network-settings) for the connection.
details.long_description: This is the first packet sent by the client to initiate the [client login process](). If the [`protocol_version`](#$type-$root-$field-protocol-version) is not supported by the server, it should send an appropriate [`PlayStatus`](play-status) packet to indicate this to the client. If the version checks out, a [`NetworkSettings`](network-settings) packet should be sent to the client in reply.

fields.name: protocol_version
fields.description: The version of the Minecraft Bedrock Protocol used by the client.
